home.title: David Somadina Obichukwu (xTc) | Software Developer, Product Builder and Designer
home.description: David Somadina Obichukwu (xTc) is an AI assisted software developer, product builder, UI/UX designer and game developer from Nigeria. Work includes PitchIT, EchoMind and Haunting Mother.

pitchit.title: PitchIT | A marketplace for every kind of work in Nigeria, by David Somadina Obichukwu
pitchit.description: PitchIT is a Flutter and Supabase marketplace for every kind of work in Nigeria, founded and designed by David Somadina Obichukwu (xTc). Try the interactive demo and read the case study.

echomind.title: EchoMind | Private journaling and mood app by David Obichukwu
echomind.description: EchoMind is a private Android app for journaling and tracking how you feel, designed and built in Flutter by David Obichukwu (xTc). Case study, screenshots, features and MVP status.

haunting.title: Haunting Mother | Multiplayer horror puzzle game on Roblox by David Obichukwu
haunting.description: Haunting Mother is a published multiplayer horror puzzle game on Roblox, designed and built in Roblox Studio by David Obichukwu (xTc). Play it on Roblox and read the development case study.
